The Batman (2022)

In The Batman (2022), a second-year Bruce Wayne (Robert Pattinson) investigates a sadistic serial killer, The Riddler (Paul Dano), who is murdering Gotham’s corrupt elite and targeting Batman to reveal the truth about the city’s corruption. Alongside Lt. James Gordon (Jeffrey Wright) and Selina Kyle/Catwoman (Zoë Kravitz), Batman uncovers deep-seated connections between his own family, crime lord Carmine Falcone, and the GCPD.

source_details.synopsis: The Batman is a 2022 American superhero film directed by Matt Reeves from a screenplay he wrote with Peter Craig. Based on the DC Comics character Batman, it is a reboot of the Batman film franchise. Robert Pattinson stars as Bruce Wayne / Batman alongside Zoë Kravitz, Paul Dano, Jeffrey Wright, John Turturro, Peter Sarsgaard, Andy Serkis, and Colin Farrell. The film follows Batman, in his second year fighting crime in Gotham City, as he uncovers corruption with ties to his own family while pursuing the Riddler (Dano), a mysterious serial killer and terrorist targeting the city's elite.
